title: euploca salicoides

This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, treating fever, and alleviating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Euploca salicoides include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
